intro: Jobs similar to landscaping and groundskeeping workers are outdoor and equipment-heavy trades. By O*NET 31.0 data, the closest are surface mining excavating machine operators (74% similar), Floor Sanders and Finishers (73%) and septic tank and sewer pipe cleaners (73%).
shared: These careers share physical work outdoors, running powered equipment and finishing a job site by a set time. O*NET rates operation and control at 3 out of 5 for landscaping workers. Construction finishing, quarry work and fence building use the same hands-on skills. None needs more preparation than groundskeeping, and 18 of the 20 pay more than the $39,150 landscaping median.

faq.q: Which jobs like landscaping pay more?
faq.a: 18 of the 20 similar careers pay more. Terrazzo Workers and Finishers earn $76,170 (95% more), Pile Driver Operators $73,300 (87% more) and rail-track equipment operators $70,070 (79% more), according to BLS May 2025 data, all with similar preparation.

faq.q: Is heavy equipment work similar to landscaping?
faq.a: Yes. Surface mining excavating and loading machine operators are the closest match at 74% similar. They earn a BLS May 2025 median of $57,430, which is 47% more than landscaping workers, and usually train on the job with no extra schooling.
